description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget named 'ReviewCard' used to display user reviews, ratings, and associated statistics within an e-commerce application.

classes.name: ReviewCard
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a review summary, including overall rating, number of reviews, and individual star ratings with progress bars.

classes.name: RateBar
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a horizontal bar representing the proportion of reviews for a specific star rating.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the 'ReviewCard' widget layout including rating display and rating breakdown bars.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the 'RateBar' widget layout showing a label and a progress indicator for star ratings.
